class.name: IfcPointOnSurface
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A point on surface is a point which lies on a parametric surface. The point is determined by evaluating the surface at a particular pair of parameter values. NOTE: Corresponding ISO 10303 entity: point_on_surface. Please refer to ISO/IS 10303-42:1994, p. 24 for the final definition of the formal standard. HISTORY: New entity in Release IFC2x Edition 2. Inform

members.member: The surface to which the parameter values relate.
The first parameter value of the point location.
The second parameter value of the point location.
